rationale: D1, data-informed (not zero-shot): the first candidate of the clock spec for inverse flames. The train table shows that the ambient fuel fraction decides whether an inverse flame self-extinguishes (5-18 s at 7-9 % fuel, about 50 s at 14 %, not at all at 17 % and above), that air-injected flames either flash out or hold, that the burner temperature limit ends oxygen-rich tests in a fuel-rich ambient the sooner the lower the flow, and that most of the remaining tests end at a 66 s script stop. Numbers typed from the train table by the author; no fit, no search.
